description: The forge and remote calls each frozen skill and built-in review makes, as `bench-tools frozen-forge probe` runs them. A command runs through `sh -c` in the attempt's clone; `{{name}}` stands for a shell-quoted value of the target. `expect` is `answer` (exit 0, answered from the frozen forge), `checks` (`gh pr checks`: exit 0, 1 or 8, or no checks reported), `refusal` (a nonzero exit, as the forge itself would refuse it, for `reason`) or `origin-branch` (exit 0 exactly when the upstream holds a branch named as the head branch); it may differ for a pull request from a fork (`cross_repository`) and one from a branch of the same repository (`same_repository`).

calls.command: gh pr view {{number}} --json title,body,baseRefName,headRefName,headRefOid,isCrossRepository,url,files,reviews,comments --jq '{title, body, baseRefName, headRefName, headRefOid, isCrossRepository, url, files: [.files[].path], hasPriorComments: ((.reviews | map(select(.state != "APPROVED" or .body != "")) | length) > 0 or (.comments | length) > 0)}'

calls.reason: a fork's head branch is not on the upstream repository, so the fetch finds only an upstream branch of the same name; the skill then omits PR_HEAD_REF, because that commit is not headRefOid

calls.command: git fetch --no-tags origin {{base_ref}} && git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD

calls.reason: a fork's head branch is not on the upstream repository, so the fetch finds only an upstream branch of the same name

calls.command: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{{number}}/comments --jq '.[] | {path: .path, line: .line, body: .body, created_at: .created_at, user: .user.login}'
gh api graphql -f owner={{owner}} -f name={{name}} -F number={{number}} -f query={{query:ROOT_QUERY}}
gh api graphql -f owner={{owner}} -f name={{name}} -F number={{number}} -f after={{cursor:reviews}} -f query={{query:pr_continuation_query("reviews")}}
gh api graphql -f owner={{owner}} -f name={{name}} -F number={{number}} -f after={{cursor:reviewThreads}} -f query={{query:pr_continuation_query("reviewThreads")}}
gh api graphql -f owner={{owner}} -f name={{name}} -F number={{number}} -f after={{cursor:comments}} -f query={{query:pr_continuation_query("comments")}}
gh api graphql -f owner={{owner}} -f name={{name}} -F number={{number}} -f after={{cursor:closingIssuesReferences}} -f query={{query:pr_continuation_query("closingIssuesReferences")}}
gh api graphql -f thread={{thread}} -f after={{cursor:thread-comments}} -f query={{query:THREAD_COMMENTS_QUERY}}
gh api graphql -f owner={{issue_owner}} -f name={{issue_name}} -F issue={{issue}} -f query={{query:ISSUE_QUERY}}
gh api graphql -f owner={{issue_owner}} -f name={{issue_name}} -F issue={{issue}} -f after={{cursor:issue-comments}} -f query={{query:ISSUE_COMMENTS_QUERY}}

calls.reason: review-head tracks refs/pull/<n>/head, which no remote-tracking branch stores, as after `gh pr checkout`; the prompt then falls back to the main range
